packages_not_loaded.title: Plex Dashboard: packages not enabled
packages_not_loaded.description:
The Plex Dashboard package was written to `/config/packages/plex_dashboard.yaml`, but it doesn't appear to be loaded.

Add this to your `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
```

lovelace_internals_unavailable.title: Plex Dashboard: cannot auto-register dashboard
lovelace_internals_unavailable.description:
Plex Dashboard could not auto-register the Lovelace dashboard because the Home Assistant Lovelace storage internals it uses changed in this HA version.

**Error:** `{error}`

The dashboard YAML was still written to `/config/dashboards/plex_dashboard.yaml`, so you can register it manually:

1. **Settings → Dashboards → Add Dashboard → From YAML**
2. URL: `{url_path}`, Title: `Plex`, Icon: `mdi:plex`
3. Filename: `dashboards/plex_dashboard.yaml`

Please open an issue at {issue_url} with your HA version so we can restore auto-registration.
